title: Copilot Studio: MCP-compliant tools in agents and workflows
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates where registry tool restrictions are enforced and presents a pair of PowerShell command names as a runnable endpoint-filtering call. Its open licensing question also overlooks the documented inclusion of standard-harness tools for authenticated, licensed employees.
